module.purpose: This client-side file adapts the booking experience to the web application by initializing booking state, reading navigation and session context, coordinating booking-related hooks, and supplying the resulting data and actions to the rendered booking interface.
module.summary: The file provides a web integration layer for the booking flow. It combines server-provided or client-fetched event data with URL parameters, authenticated session information, persisted overlay preferences, responsive layout selection, scheduling data, availability, calendars, bookings, email verification, and code verification. It also manages navigation for instant meetings, calendar overlays, login continuation, rescheduling, and embed contexts before rendering the booking experience inside its state provider.
module.businessContext: This supports scheduling and rescheduling meetings through the web booking journey. If it fails, visitors may be unable to load availability, prefill booking details, verify contact information, or complete navigation into calendar and meeting flows.
